subject: Teaching Fellows pilot — promotional allocation & trial extension request
messages:
From: Dr. Anita Suresh <anita.suresh@stateuniv.edu>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Teaching Fellows Program <tfp@teachingfellows.org>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: pilot credits for Winter Teaching Fellows cohort

Hi Priyom,

Hope you’re well — I’m coordinating a small pilot for our Winter Teaching Fellows (graduate student instructors who run pedagogy workshops for incoming undergrads). We’d love to try Redwood for two pieces: an interactive syllabus assistant (student-facing) and an instructor-facing feedback summarizer.

We’ve got limited program funds this term. Would Redwood consider a promotional credit allocation or short trial extension to run an 8-week pilot for ~40 fellows (estimated monthly usage: ~25k–40k tokens depending on prompt frequency)? I attached a sample syllabus and a short pilot plan.

Key asks:
- Promotional credits for the pilot (preferably usable across both use cases)
- A 30–60 day trial extension on top of the standard trial
- Quick MOU or simple terms we can route through our procurement team

If helpful, we’re happy to provide a short case study or a public quote after the pilot (non-identifying).

Thanks — looking forward to your thoughts.

Best,
Dr. Anita Suresh
Director, Teaching Fellows Program
State University
Attachments: Syllabus_Sample.pdf
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Anita Suresh <anita.suresh@stateuniv.edu>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-21T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: pilot credits for Winter Teaching Fellows cohort

Hi Anita — great to hear about the program, thanks for the details and the syllabus. I’ve looped in Ben from our education team to scope an appropriate promo. A couple questions to size this properly:

- When you say ~25k–40k tokens/month, is that per fellow or total across the cohort?
- Any expected PII in prompts (student names, grades)? If so we’ll flag for data handling guidance.
- Do you have a procurement contact for a short MOU? If not, we can circulate a simple agreement for signature.

Ben — can you recommend a promotional allocation and whether we should offer a time-limited voucher vs. direct credit on the account?

Thanks — Priyom

--
Priyom Das
Growth, Education & Research Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-23T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: pilot credits for Winter Teaching Fellows cohort

Forwarding Anita’s request — pilot looks like a textbook education use-case. My quick take: offer a two-part package: 1) promotional token allocation to cover the first 8 weeks, 2) a 30-day trial extension for onboarding + smoothing usage spikes.

Suggested numbers (can revise):
- Promo allocation: 50,000 tokens (account-level credit / voucher)
- Trial extension: 30 days beyond typical trial expiration
- Condition: agreement to a short (1–2 page) MOU and allowance to publish a non-identifying case study summary

I’m attaching a draft MOU and a DocuSign placeholder. If leadership is comfortable, we can make this a standard education promo and track outcomes in HubSpot (deal attached).

Marissa — approving 50k would be fine from an onboarding standpoint? If not, please advise on cap.

Thanks,
Ben
Attachments: MOU_TeachingFellows_v1.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-24T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: pilot credits for Winter Teaching Fellows cohort

Thanks for the context. I’m supportive of backing education pilots, but want to balance out promo spend vs. signal. Approving a partial allocation now so they can get started quickly:

- Approve: 30,000-token promotional allocation (voucher)
- Approve: 30-day trial extension
- Condition: MOU signed and a short (1-paragraph) public case study summary shared after pilot completion — legal to review non-identifying language

If the program needs more than 30k in the pilot period, escalate to me with estimated uplift and intended ROI (student reach, published outputs). Ben — please share the voucher code and MOU link with Anita. Priyom — help with customer intro and kickoff coordination.

Marissa
VP, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Dr. Anita Suresh <anita.suresh@stateuniv.edu>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-25T10:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Teaching Fellows pilot — promotional allocation & trial extension request

Priyom / Ben — thank you, this is excellent news and very helpful for our planning. We accept the 30,000-token allocation and the 30-day extension.

Next steps from our side:
- I’ll route the MOU to our procurement office (contact: Joel Ramirez, joel.ramirez@stateuniv.edu) — please send the DocuSign link so we can sign electronically.
- We agree to the non-identifying case study summary; we’ll loop in our communications team for approvals.
- Proposed kickoff week: Dec 6 (2-hour orientation + integration session) — does that work on your side?

Please send the voucher/code and any quickstart notes we should give instructors.

Best,
Anita

--
Dr. Anita Suresh
Director, Teaching Fellows Program, State University
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Anita Suresh <anita.suresh@stateuniv.edu>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-27T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Teaching Fellows pilot — promotional allocation & trial extension request

Hi Anita — delighted to confirm the details below. Attachments: promo_voucher_20261127.pdf (voucher code), MOU_TeachingFellows_v1.pdf (DocuSign link inside).

Summary of what we’ve provisioned:
- Voucher: 30,000 tokens (promo_voucher_20261127.pdf attached) — redeemable once on the account listed in the MOU
- Trial extension: 30 days starting from account activation date in the DocuSign MOU
- MOU: please sign via the DocuSign link included in the PDF; Joel Ramirez is cc’ing procurement on your side per Anita’s note
- Kickoff: Dec 6 works from our side; Ben will lead the integration session and onboarding materials.

Quickstart notes (high level):
1) Use prefix caching for syllabus assistant prompts to keep prompts small and reduce token use.
2) Turn on instructor-only logs (we’ll share a guide) if you expect grading-related PII — we recommend anonymizing student identifiers.
3) If you exceed the promo allocation, Ben will coordinate a short top-up with Marissa’s approval.

Ben — please confirm you’ve uploaded the voucher to HubSpot and share any onboarding links.

Thanks all — looking forward to the pilot.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Growth, Education & Research Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Attachments: promo_voucher_20261127.pdf, MOU_TeachingFellows_v1.pdf
